seo.title: Jewellery valuations and auctions in Chelsea
seo.description: Free jewellery valuations at our Chelsea saleroom or from photographs, and fine jewellery in our auctions.

hero.title: Jewellery
hero.text: Fine jewellery features in many of our sales. Our jewellery specialist offers free valuations, from photographs or in person at our Chelsea saleroom.

valuation.title: Request a jewellery valuation
